rebalance_callable_by_any_caller.meaning: rebalanceFunds is external and unprotected so any caller can invoke it

buffer_funds_above_target.meaning: the buffer holds funds above targetBufferPercentageBPS that can be swept to the custodian

minimum_buffer_remains_unswept.meaning: the minimum on-chain buffer remains present and has not been swept to the custodian

buffer_drained_to_minimum_occurred.meaning: the buffer has been repeatedly drained to the minimum (or lower if target is small) by the attacker

assumptions: rebalanceFunds is the only path by which the buffer is swept to the custodian.
The minimum buffer is defined by targetBufferPercentageBPS; its concrete numeric value is not stated in the report.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a concrete numeric value for targetBufferPercentageBPS or the buffer amount, so the minimum-buffer bound cannot be expressed numerically; the preservation of the minimum buffer is represented as a grounded Boolean state.
The conditional 'or lower if target is small' is not given a fixed bound or threshold, so the below-target subcase cannot be formalized as a numeric relation.

limitations: The safety property is a preservation invariant: under the unprotected-callable and above-target conditions, the minimum buffer must remain unswept; the report's potential modality is preserved by treating the drain as a possible occurrence rather than an inevitable one.
The minimum-buffer threshold is symbolic; no numeric targetBufferPercentageBPS value is available for a bounded comparison.
Only the buffer_drained_to_minimum impact is formalized here; other impacts are out of scope for this plan.
